<thought>To disconnect the central C=C bond of 4,4'-dimethoxystilbene, the Peterson reaction is appropriate. In the forward direction it forms the C=C bond while losing a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group. Retrosynthetically, the alkene can be traced back to a diaryl ketone (4,4'-dimethoxybenzophenone) and a trimethylsilyl carbanion (Me₃SiCH₂⁻). I will search for a template that matches these functional‑group changes.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
